lines: At the end of the bridge yell 'Recruiter Sanadaren has sent me to learn about the true path to everlasting life.'
Then wait there until a guard comes and escorts you across the bridge.
C - steel door to the north - child apparition appears here
B - book with a loose page
T - flying over the mote (drops you down even if you fly)
R - Room with 2 guards guarding the drawbridge
North of the bridge is a (fly? only exit) hole with aggressive eels.
<worn on head>      a black chain helm
<worn on legs>      a pair of black chain greaves
<worn on feet>      a pair of black scale boots
<worn about body>   a patched cape with a gray emblem
R - recruiter (a signet ring, a robe - about)
K - The Bottom of a Black Tower: Krendallig (the Axe of Bereavement - defilement, the shield of Baraktong), Tresteni

T - Throne Room:                 Montikar (Robe of the Faithful, Buldiniar, Hammer of the Faithful), Rastraklyn (Helm of Maraktok, pair of ebonscale greaves, Hooves of the Beast,  whip named 'Golinthaur')
H - Hestafles (a pair of ebonscale greaves, a pair of ebonscale hooves, a hooked sword)
B - Beklines (putrid dagger, an ioun stone)
